title: the rehearsal's host image is cached, pinned and bounded

findings.claim: the box rehearsal's step host-image built its Ubuntu image from Docker Hub and archive.ubuntu.com on every run, unpinned, uncached and with no cap, so a mirror outage failed it (500 s, 112 s on train 98) and a slow mirror took 46 minutes; CI only, it reddens trains
findings.expected: the host image comes from a cache keyed on its Dockerfile's hash, or a bounded, retried build that fails naming its fetch
findings.happened: jobs 135547205491 (FAIL 500 s, archive.ubuntu.com:80 unable to connect), 135547205395 (FAIL 112 s, Unable to locate package), 135387999040 (2758 s)
